info.title: Basis API — workspaces
info.description:
Normative HTTP contract for Basis. Paths use /api/v1 prefix.

**Two surfaces** (see x-basis-surface on each operation):
- `platform` — console & system/org admin; **session JWT** (`sessionAuth`).
- `workspaces` — workspace data & integration (MCP parity); **session or workspace API token** (`workspaceApiTokenAuth`, scoped by `workspace_id`).

Split specs: `/openapi/v1/platform.json`, `/openapi/v1/workspaces.json` (workspace **integration** contract). Console-only routes may appear here but are omitted from the workspace integration slice (see x-basis-audience: console). MCP: POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/mcp. Docs: docs/architecture/openapi-v1.md.

get.description:
List workspace alert episodes with unread count (viewer+).

Each alert includes a `detail` object (JSON). Common keys by `kind`:

- `governance.tripped`: `code`, `decision_id`, `item_id`, `proposal_id`,
  `shacl_violation_count`, `episode_key`
- `processing.failed`: `job_id`, `error_code`, `message`, `episode_key`
- `sync_failed`: `source_id`, `source_name`, `mode`, `error`, `episode_key`
`episode_key` correlates multiple rows in the UI (F-ALT).

get.description:
Whole-graph diff between two instants (F-DIFF-01).

Compares graph projection snapshots at `from` and `to` (ISO instants). Response includes
`added_nodes`, `removed_nodes`, `modified_nodes`, `added_edges`, `removed_edges`, `summary`,
and echo `from_time` / `to_time`. Node/edge membership follows ledger `recorded_at` → projected
`valid_from` and `invalidated_at` → projected `valid_until` (F-TIM-01). Console graph preview dims unchanged elements and highlights
added/modified nodes and added edges at the end instant.

schema.title: Response Graph Diff Api V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Graph Diff Get

allowed_operations.title: Allowed Operations
allowed_operations.description: Deprecated: sets both MCP and OpenAPI grants when the split fields are omitted.

mcp_allowed_operations.title: Mcp Allowed Operations
mcp_allowed_operations.description: MCP tool names this token may call; omit for unrestricted MCP.

http_allowed_operations.title: Http Allowed Operations
http_allowed_operations.description: Workspace REST route grant ids; omit for unrestricted OpenAPI.

import_demo_data.title: Import Demo Data
import_demo_data.description: When true, seed the workspace with the built-in demo pack (documents, mappings, reasoning).

governance_ontology_uri.title: Governance Ontology Uri
governance_ontology_uri.description: Ontology URI for Hub SHACL during conflict scans (empty clears).

vocabulary_alignment_requires_review.title: Vocabulary Alignment Requires Review
vocabulary_alignment_requires_review.description: When true, vocabulary alignment upsert/delete enqueue review before publish. Omit to leave unchanged.

ontology_uri.title: Ontology Uri
ontology_uri.description: Ontology URI these shapes apply to (also sets scan URI).

shacl_turtle.title: Shacl Turtle
shacl_turtle.description: Persisted SHACL Turtle for governance scans (empty clears saved shapes).

include_shacl.title: Include Shacl
include_shacl.description: Run SHACL violation scan (mapped ledger facts).

include_entity_label_clusters.title: Include Entity Label Clusters
include_entity_label_clusters.description: Enqueue ledger entities sharing the same canonical label.

include_graph_dedup.title: Include Graph Dedup
include_graph_dedup.description: Enqueue graph semantic duplicate pairs (requires graph runtime).

include_unmapped_entity_types.title: Include Unmapped Entity Types
include_unmapped_entity_types.description: Enqueue taxonomic object labels without a confirmed class mapping (L2).

at.title: At
at.description: Optional temporal instant (ISO). When set, results are limited to nodes active at that instant.

include_archived.title: Include Archived
include_archived.description: When true, include projection nodes with status=archived in search results.

entity_type_surface_phrases.title: Entity Type Surface Phrases
entity_type_surface_phrases.description: Relation phrases treated as rdf:type for class mapping materialization (e.g. 是, is_a). Use GET/PUT …/governance/interpretation (L2 alignment policy).

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Non-empty list of forward-chaining rule strings (IF … THEN …).

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: Ground facts as predicate(Subject, Object) strings. Omit or pass an empty array to derive from materialized typed_facts (up to facts_limit).

facts_limit.title: Facts Limit
facts_limit.description: Max typed_facts rows when facts is omitted or empty.

apply_to_graph.title: Apply To Graph
apply_to_graph.description: When true, persist inferred edges and derived facts (requires editor role).

inferred_edge_type.title: Inferred Edge Type
inferred_edge_type.description: Optional edge type label when apply_to_graph is true.

chunk_id.title: Chunk Id
chunk_id.description: Optional ledger chunk id to cite on inferred edges when apply_to_graph is true.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Optional quote override for chunk_id evidence.

chunk_id.title: Chunk Id
chunk_id.description: Optional ledger chunk to cite as evidence for this proposal.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Optional quote override when chunk_id is set.

primary_id.title: Primary Id
primary_id.description: For `entity_cluster` approve: ledger entity id to keep as primary (F-GOV-04).

confirmation.title: Confirmation
confirmation.description: Must match the workspace display name exactly.

async.title: Async
async.description: Run reset in background; poll GET …/ingest/jobs/{job_id}.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Subset to clear: knowledge, graph, connectors, reasoning, governance.

sessionAuth.description: User session JWT from POST /api/v1/auth/login (console / platform admin).

workspaceApiTokenAuth.description: Workspace-scoped API token (read or write). Token must include this workspace_id. Same tokens as MCP (Authorization: Bearer). Created under workspace settings → Integration (session only).

platform.description: Platform & admin APIs for the web console and operators.

workspaces.description: Workspace-scoped APIs (`/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}`); same access model as MCP (workspace API token or user session with workspace role).

console.description: Web console application HTTP (not integration/core); excluded from workspace integration slice.
